newsitem.title: USA: Universal Foods CEO Manning named chairman.
newsitem.headline: Universal Foods CEO Manning named chairman.

text.p: Universal Foods Corp said Thursday it elected Kenneth Manning, its president and chief executive officer, its new chairman, effective April 30.

The company said the current chairman, Guy Osborn, will retire from the company and resign as chairman on that date after serving in the post since 1990. Osborn will continue to serve on the board of directors, Universal Foods said.
Manning was named president in 1992 and added the chief executive title in October of 1996, the company said.
Universal Foods is a food ingredient supplier.
Its shares closed down 3/8 Thursday at 33-1/2.
